title: Purchases: no match
summary: Diceroll's Purchases searched for a license id that has no purchase in the last 28 days: the table head stays, and the kit's filtered empty state names what matched nothing, says it may have been bought earlier, and offers Search all time and Clear search.
compare: Filtered to nothing (EXPERIENCE.md §9): the tabs, toolbar and table head stay; the body is one empty state, never a blank table.
The title quotes what was searched (in mono for an id) and the active date filter ('in the last 28 days'); one sentence: it may have been bought earlier (Search all time is the way to it).
Two ways out: Search all time (drops the date filter, keeps the search) and Clear search; the search field also has its own clear button.
Loading uses skeleton rows shaped like the ledger's columns (no 'Loading…' text); an error replaces the body with what happened, Try again and a reference id.
Phone: the table head hides and the empty state centres in the card; the buttons stack.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
Filtered-empty keeps the band and the table head (admin-3-13).
